verdict_scope: Static visual quality against retrieved publisher screenshots. Runtime functionality, animation, autonomy, input and performance not validated by this static review.
biggest_remaining_gap: The room and mechanisms read as primitive geometric blockout rather than a crafted, inhabited escape room. Material richness, component construction and a developed character are missing from the inspected output.

findings.observed: The room consists largely of near-black wall planes, simple brown planks, cylinders, a grid-like floor, and isolated gold/cyan primitives. Most broad surfaces have no visible grain, wear, trim, or texture variation.
findings.comparison: The Room 4 library screenshot separates carved wood panels, books, glass, brass, paper, framed art, patterned floor inlays and structural molding, with detail at multiple scales.
findings.required_change: Make the room architectural: dimensional paneling, ceiling structure, proportioned furniture, readable material variation and contextual prop clusters. Establish a key-lit hero station and fill sufficient to retain readable forms.

findings.observed: The mechanism capture presents an empty dark door rectangle with one gold ring. The neighboring small wheel is obscured by broad shelf uprights. Close viewing magnifies simple geometry rather than revealing richer construction.
findings.comparison: The Room 4 safe and workbench have nested forms, toothed controls, layered housings, hinges/fasteners, coils, varied metal finishes and clear relationships among physical parts.
findings.required_change: Build each major mechanism as a distinctive assembly with controls, moving parts, housing and readable clues. Frame an inspection shot so the selected device occupies the center and its controls remain unobstructed.

findings.observed: No identifiable developed character is visible in the three supplied captures. A small dark ball-like form near the desk does not establish a readable face, clothing, hands, or personality.
findings.comparison: The Escape Simulator reference supplies a strongly legible full-body silhouette with coiffed hair, glasses, clothing seams, hands and boots, coherently lit in the room.
findings.required_change: Put at least one recognizable, proportioned character in the main staging and make their exploration/interaction pose visible. Distinguish appearance, clothing, accessories and expression at the intended viewer distance.

findings.observed: Large contiguous areas are almost black. Gold/cyan spheres and rings carry the brightest highlights while the room shell and working surfaces remain difficult to read. Multiple suspended spheres do not visibly attach to lamp fixtures.
findings.comparison: Both reference rooms have motivated practical light sources and spatially useful warm/cool relationships; the dark Room 4 library still exposes furnishings and layered surfaces.
findings.required_change: Use complete light fixtures and position key, fill and rim illumination around the hero puzzle and character. Retain shadow atmosphere while revealing the room shell and object boundaries.

findings.observed: The outer HUD uses a coherent dark/cyan/gold palette and the main AI-intent sentence is readable. However the room/tick labels, top-center help, progress captions and several secondary labels are extremely small at the supplied 1600×1000 view. They read as texture rather than information.
findings.comparison: The reference mechanism images let the physical subject dominate; their visual hierarchy does not require decoding many tiny peripheral labels.
findings.required_change: Increase useful secondary text, remove low-value captions, and prioritize objective, current action, progress and imminent result. A viewer should understand the current task without scanning several tiny corners.

findings.observed: The result capture changes the progress display to 100%, shows 8/8 and a green door frame, but retains almost the same room composition and sparse objects. It is a state indication, not yet a visually rewarding escape moment.
findings.comparison: This is a quality judgment from the game capture; no reference gameplay outcome was observed.
findings.required_change: Give escape a composed camera moment, a physical open threshold with a visible destination or light, and character movement/response. Verify that the result is understandable from motion as well as HUD text.

positive_observations: The cyan/gold/dark UI palette is consistent.
The result capture visibly distinguishes 0/8 from 8/8 and 0% from 100%.
A spatial 3D room, a door and multiple stations are visible.
next_review_requirements: A bright enough room-wide composition with architecture, developed character, distinctive hero mechanisms and contextual props.
At least two unobstructed mechanism closeups showing physical controls and rich component construction.
Actual runtime observation for interaction, autonomous action, physical state changes and complete escape; screenshots alone cannot establish these.
